verdict.rationale: Mercury's API/MCP/CLI surface covers most core banking actions available in the UI — accounts, transactions, cards (including virtual card issuance and lifecycle control), invoicing/AR, payments (ACH/wire/check), transfers, categories, statements, webhooks, and OAuth2 access (mercury-docs-12,13,36,46,53,57,15) — and Mercury explicitly markets 'a full banking API, terminal-native CLI, and AI-ready MCP server' (mercury-docs-40). However, several UI-surfaced capabilities (account opening/onboarding, cashback/rewards redemption, QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite sync automation, universal search, accountant one-click permission flows) are not documented as API-accessible, and no vendor statement claims full UI/API parity. Missing for 10: explicit parity claim, API endpoints for onboarding/rewards/accounting-sync features, and independent confirmation that no UI action lacks an API equivalent.
